heading: Professional Dog Grooming
blockquote: Trusted dog grooming delivered with experience, patience and genuine care.
body:
Every dog deserves to feel comfortable, understood and beautifully cared for. From our welcoming salon in Congresbury, our qualified groomers provide professional grooming tailored to your dog’s breed, coat, lifestyle and personality.

Whether your dog needs a regular bath and tidy, a full groom, specialist hand stripping or a little extra patience, we take the time to make the experience as calm and positive as possible. Dog owners visit us from across North Somerset, including Yatton, Clevedon, Weston-super-Mare, Wrington, Winscombe and the surrounding areas.
